{{Top|leg}}
The '''KD57 3-chamber repulsorlift engine''' was an engine unit manufactured by [[Karydee]]. The majority of [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barges]] used these [[Engine/Legends|engines]], as they were capable of moving the vessels over most types of terrain, including water, sand, ice or snow.
